BOMB SCARE FORCES LONDON FLIGHT TO MAKE EMERGENCY LANDING IN POLAND

A passenger plane travelling from London Heathrow to Warsaw was diverted after a suspected bomb threat was reported on board.

The Polish Airlines Boeing 737, carrying 181 people, landed safely at Warsaw-Modlin Airport at around 10am.

The airport was temporarily closed as bomb disposal teams and emergency services rushed to inspect the aircraft and passengers’ luggage.

A second aircraft, arriving from Copenhagen, was also subject to a separate bomb threat investigation at Warsaw Chopin Airport.

Warsaw-Modlin Airport has since reopened, but security checks are continuing.

No explosives have been confirmed.

Source: Scottish Sun
